// Each ring's gradient: a petal's slot reads one place on the palette, rings out and back over the period, or round
// the flower by its spoke's angle; each place's color shaded and tinted at the design's stops, in bytes.
function shade(c, f, chroma = 1.08) {
  const [L, C, H] = srgbToLch(c);
  const h = ((H % 360) + 360) % 360;
  let turn = 0;
  if (C > 0.02 && h > 60 && h < 140) {
    const w = (h < 70 ? (h - 60) / 10 : h > 130 ? (140 - h) / 10 : 1) * Math.min(1, (C - 0.02) / 0.03);
    turn = -w * (h - 55) * Math.min(1, (1 - f) * 2.4);
  }
  return lchToSrgb(L * f, C * chroma, H + turn);
}
function tint(c, f) {
  const [L, C, H] = srgbToLch(c);
  return lchToSrgb(L + (1 - L) * f, C * (1 - 0.35 * f + 0.4 * (1 - L) * (1 - L)), H);
}
const byte = v => Math.round(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v)) * 255) / 255;
const bytes = c => [byte(c[0]), byte(c[1]), byte(c[2])];
const slotOf = (d, n) => (((n + d.phase) % d.flow) + d.flow) % d.flow;
function slotT(d, slot) {
  if (d.coloring === "angular") {
    const m = slot - d.phase;
    const n = m - d.flow * Math.round((m + 20) / d.flow);
    const a = (d.hand * GOLDEN * n + d.turn0) / TAU;
    return 1 - Math.abs(2 * (a - Math.floor(a)) - 1);
  }
  return 1 - Math.abs((2 * slot) / d.flow - 1);
}
function rosetteColors(d) {
  const at = t => sampleSrgb(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, d.reverse ? 1 - t : t)));
  const grads = [];
  const byT = new Map();
  const keyOfSlot = [];
  for (let slot = 0; slot < d.flow; slot++) {
    const t = Math.round(slotT(d, slot) * 1e6) / 1e6;
    let key = byT.get(t);
    if (key === undefined) {
      key = grads.length;
      byT.set(t, key);
      const c = at(t);
      grads.push(
        d.stops.map(([, tone]) =>
          bytes(tone < 0 ? shade(c, 1 + tone * (1 - d.shadeF), 1 - 0.1 * tone) : tone > 0 ? tint(c, tone * d.tintF) : c)
        )
      );
    }
    keyOfSlot.push(key);
  }
  const h0 = at(0);
  const Lh = srgbToLch(h0)[0];
  const heart = bytes(tint(h0, 0.35 * Lh * Lh));
  let deepest = at(0);
  let dl = 2;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 16; i++) {
    const c = at(i / 16);
    const l = srgbToLch(c)[0];
    if (l < dl) {
      dl = l;
      deepest = c;
    }
  }
  return { grads, keyOfSlot, heart, ground: bytes(shade(deepest, 0.5, 1)) };
}

// The flower in a canvas of W by H pixels at ANGLE and SHAPE: its design turned to the angle, the lattice, the lens, the
// rings' colors and its scale S, the box's longer side times SPAN.
function rosetteScene(angle, shape, W, H) {
  const design = { ...rosetteDesign(shape) };
  design.turn0 += ((angle - 90) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const lattice = latticeOf(design);
  return { design, lattice, lens: lensOf(design, lattice), colors: rosetteColors(design), box: { width: W, height: H }, S: SPAN * Math.max(W, H) };
}
const groupAt = (sc, tau) => ({ zoom: Math.exp(sc.lattice.k * sc.design.flow * tau), turn: sc.lattice.beta * tau });
function inBox(sc, r, th, pad = 2) {
  const ax = r * Math.cos(th);
  const ay = r * Math.sin(th);
  const gx = Math.max(0, Math.abs(ax) - sc.box.width / 2);
  const gy = Math.max(0, Math.abs(ay) - sc.box.height / 2);
  return gx * gx + gy * gy <= (r * sc.lens.reach + pad) ** 2;
}
// The petals any time of the loop shows: from the one whose tip reaches out of the heart's middle at the loop's end to
// the last whose reach meets the box at one of 25 times of the loop.
function rosettePetals(sc) {
  const { k, alpha } = sc.lattice;
  const d = sc.design;
  const L = sc.lens;
  const inner = d.heartIn * sc.S;
  const lo = Math.ceil(Math.log(inner / (sc.S * L.outer)) / k) - d.flow;
  const near = Math.max(0.02, 1 - L.reach);
  const corner = Math.hypot(sc.box.width, sc.box.height) / 2 / sc.S;
  const hi = Math.floor(Math.log(corner / near) / k) + 1;
  const out = [];
  const steps = 24;
  for (let n = hi; n >= lo; n--) {
    const r = sc.S * Math.exp(k * n);
    const th = alpha * n + d.turn0;
    let keep = false;
    for (let s = 0; s <= steps && !keep; s++) {
      const g = groupAt(sc, s / Math.max(1, steps));
      keep = inBox(sc, r * g.zoom, th + g.turn, 4);
    }
    if (keep) out.push(n);
  }
  return out;
}
// The most a lens reaches round from its anchor's direction, radians: its arcs sampled, with a margin.
function angMaxOf(sc) {
  const L = sc.lens;
  let most = 0;
  const a0 = Math.atan2(0 + L.d, L.x0 - L.xm);
  const a1 = Math.atan2(0 + L.d, L.x1 - L.xm);
  for (let i = 0; i <= 256; i++) {
    const a = a0 + ((a1 - a0) * i) / 256;
    const x = L.xm + L.rho * Math.cos(a);
    const y = -L.d + L.rho * Math.sin(a);
    most = Math.max(most, Math.atan2(y, x));
  }
  return most + 0.05;
}
// The shader's uniforms, as the player sets them, but uGroup, which the loop's phase sets (rosetteGroup).
function rosetteUniforms(sc) {
  const d = sc.design;
  const L = sc.lens;
  const petals = rosettePetals(sc);
  const lo = petals.reduce((m, n) => Math.min(m, n), Infinity);
  const hi = petals.reduce((m, n) => Math.max(m, n), -Infinity);
  const stop = new Float32Array(MAX_KEYS * 4 * 3);
  sc.colors.grads.forEach((g, k) => {
    g.forEach((c, j) => {
      stop.set(c, (k * 4 + j) * 3);
    });
  });
  const keyOfSlot = new Int32Array(MAX_KEYS);
  keyOfSlot.set(sc.colors.keyOfSlot.slice(0, MAX_KEYS));
  return {
    uBox: [sc.box.width, sc.box.height],
    uS: sc.S,
    uK: sc.lattice.k,
    uEk: Math.exp(-sc.lattice.k),
    uAlpha: sc.lattice.alpha,
    uTurn0: d.turn0,
    uRange: [lo, hi],
    uLens: [L.x0, L.x1, L.w, L.rho],
    uLensMid: [L.xm, L.d],
    uAngMax: angMaxOf(sc),
    uGrad: [d.grad.cu, d.grad.cv, d.grad.ru, d.grad.rv],
    uStopAt: [d.stops[0][0], d.stops[1][0], d.stops[2][0], d.stops[3][0]],
    uStop: stop,
    uKeyOfSlot: keyOfSlot,
    uFlow: d.flow,
    uPhase: d.phase,
    uGround: sc.colors.ground,
    uHeart: sc.colors.heart,
    uHeartR: [d.heartIn, d.heartOut]
  };
}
// uGroup at t seconds of the loop at speed 1: the loop's zoom (its log) and the turn the petals' group has made.
function rosetteGroup(sc, t) {
  const L = sc.design.loop;
  const tau = t / L - Math.floor(t / L);
  return [sc.lattice.k * sc.design.flow * tau, sc.lattice.beta * tau];
}

// The drawing, WebGPU, as the site's player draws it with WebGL: the same pass and numbers. Each frame is drawn into a
// texture of its own and shown on the canvas by a second pass: a finish (a soft blur, a grain) would take the frame's
// texture there.
const canvas = document.querySelector("canvas");
const request = async () => {
  const adapter = await navigator.gpu?.requestAdapter().catch(() => null);
  return (await adapter?.requestDevice().catch(() => null)) ?? null;
};
let gpu = await request();
if (gpu) play();
else document.body.textContent = "This page needs WebGPU, which this browser does not have.";

function play() {
  const context = canvas.getContext("webgpu");
  const format = navigator.gpu.getPreferredCanvasFormat();
  const pipeline = (id, target) => {
    const shader = gpu.createShaderModule({ code: document.getElementById(id).textContent });
    return gpu.createRenderPipeline({
      layout: "auto",
      vertex: { module: shader, entryPoint: "vs_main" },
      fragment: { module: shader, entryPoint: "fs_main", targets: [{ format: target }] },
      primitive: { topology: "triangle-list" }
    });
  };

  // What the GPU holds, made at the start and again on a new device where the old one is lost.
  let rosette, show, uniforms, frame, groups;
  const make = () => {
    context.configure({ device: gpu, format, alphaMode: "opaque" });
    rosette = pipeline("rosette", "rgba8unorm");
    show = pipeline("show", format);
    uniforms = gpu.createBuffer({ size: 2464, usage: GPUBufferUsage.UNIFORM | GPUBufferUsage.COPY_DST });
    frame = null;
    groups = null;
  };
  make();

  // The canvas at its size, w by h device pixels: the flower laid out for it, its uniforms in the struct's order, and
  // the frame's texture.
  let scene = null;
  const block = new ArrayBuffer(2464);
  const F = new Float32Array(block);
  const I = new Int32Array(block);
  const layout = (w, h) => {
    if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
      canvas.width = w;
      canvas.height = h;
    }
    scene = rosetteScene(ANGLE, SHAPE, w, h);
    const v = rosetteUniforms(scene);
    F.set([...v.uBox, v.uS, v.uK, v.uAlpha, v.uTurn0], 0);
    F.set([v.uEk, v.uAngMax], 8);
    I.set(v.uRange, 10);
    F.set([...v.uLens, ...v.uLensMid, ...v.uHeartR, ...v.uGrad, ...v.uStopAt, ...v.uGround], 12);
    I[31] = v.uFlow;
    F.set(v.uHeart, 32);
    I[35] = v.uPhase;
    I.set(v.uKeyOfSlot, 36);
    for (let i = 0; i < v.uStop.length / 3; i++) F.set(v.uStop.subarray(3 * i, 3 * i + 3), 72 + 4 * i);
    frame?.destroy();
    frame = gpu.createTexture({
      size: [w, h],
      format: "rgba8unorm",
      usage: GPUTextureUsage.RENDER_ATTACHMENT | GPUTextureUsage.TEXTURE_BINDING
    });
    groups = {
      rosette: gpu.createBindGroup({ layout: rosette.getBindGroupLayout(0), entries: [{ binding: 0, resource: { buffer: uniforms } }] }),
      show: gpu.createBindGroup({ layout: show.getBindGroupLayout(0), entries: [{ binding: 0, resource: frame.createView() }] })
    };
  };

  const pass = (encoder, view, p, bindings) => {
    const at = encoder.beginRenderPass({
      colorAttachments: [{ view, loadOp: "clear", clearValue: [0, 0, 0, 1], storeOp: "store" }]
    });
    at.setPipeline(p);
    at.setBindGroup(0, bindings);
    at.draw(3);
    at.end();
  };
  // A frame at t seconds of the loop at speed 1, once the canvas has a size on this device: the petals' group zoomed
  // and turned to t, the flower drawn into the frame, the frame shown on the canvas.
  const draw = t => {
    if (!groups) return;
    F.set(rosetteGroup(scene, t), 6);
    gpu.queue.writeBuffer(uniforms, 0, block);
    const encoder = gpu.createCommandEncoder();
    pass(encoder, frame.createView(), rosette, groups.rosette);
    pass(encoder, context.getCurrentTexture().createView(), show, groups.show);
    gpu.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
  };

  // The canvas's size in device pixels as the browser lays it out, up to a 4K screen's pixels, as the player sizes it.
  const PIXELS_MAX = 8300000;
  let pixels = null;
  let laidOut = false;
  const resize = () => {
    const dpr = devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const css = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!css.width || !css.height) return;
    const ew = Math.round(css.width * dpr);
    const eh = Math.round(css.height * dpr);
    const exact = pixels && Math.abs(pixels.w - ew) <= 2 && Math.abs(pixels.h - eh) <= 2;
    const w0 = exact ? pixels.w : ew;
    const h0 = exact ? pixels.h : eh;
    const fit = Math.min(1, Math.sqrt(PIXELS_MAX / Math.max(1, w0 * h0)));
    const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(w0 * fit));
    const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(h0 * fit));
    layout(w, h);
    laidOut = true;
  };

  // The clock: seconds of the loop at speed 1, advanced by SPEED, so the motion eases in from rest over EASE seconds once
  // the first frame is drawn. A frame is drawn when the picture changed or one is due at FPS; a reader who asks for
  // less motion sees the first frame.
  const reduced = matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  let lost = false;
  const playing = () => !document.hidden && !reduced.matches && !lost;
  let t = 0;
  let warm = 0;
  let last = performance.now();
  let lastDrawn = -1;
  let changed = true;
  let first = true;
  let raf = 0;
  let settle = 0;
  // A frame is due once each 1/FPS, a little early rather than a refresh late, counted from the last one's due time.
  let paced = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  const due = now => {
    if (!FPS) return true;
    const every = 1000 / FPS;
    if (now - paced < every - Math.min(4, every * 0.2)) return false;
    paced = now - paced > 2 * every ? now : paced + every;
    return true;
  };
  const tick = now => {
    raf = 0;
    if (lost) return;
    const dt = Math.min(0.1, (now - last) / 1000);
    last = now;
    if (!playing() || SPEED === 0) warm = 0;
    else if (laidOut && !first) {
      warm = Math.min(EASE, warm + dt);
      const e = EASE ? warm / EASE : 1;
      t += dt * SPEED * e * e * (3 - 2 * e);
    }
    if (laidOut) {
      const at = reduced.matches ? 0 : t;
      if (changed || (at !== lastDrawn && due(now))) {
        draw(at);
        lastDrawn = at;
        changed = false;
        first = false;
      }
    }
    if (playing() && SPEED > 0) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  const wake = () => {
    last = performance.now();
    if (!raf && !lost) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };
  // The first size comes before the first paint; a later one settles a moment before the drawing is laid out again.
  const sizes = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
    const box = entries[entries.length - 1]?.devicePixelContentBoxSize?.[0];
    pixels = box ? { w: box.inlineSize, h: box.blockSize } : null;
    clearTimeout(settle);
    settle = setTimeout(
      () => {
        resize();
        changed = true;
        wake();
      },
      laidOut ? 150 : 0
    );
  });
  try {
    sizes.observe(canvas, { box: "device-pixel-content-box" });
  } catch {
    sizes.observe(canvas);
  }
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (!document.hidden) wake();
  });
  reduced.addEventListener("change", () => {
    changed = true;
    wake();
  });
  // A GPU lost draws nothing, and the loop stops until a new drawing is made on the one found again, which is laid out
  // and drawn at once, the clock going on from where it was.
  const lose = () => {
    lost = true;
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf = 0;
  };
  const found = () => {
    lost = false;
    laidOut = false;
    resize();
    changed = true;
    wake();
  };
  // A device lost draws nothing: the page asks for another, three times at most, makes everything the GPU held again
  // on it and goes on, or says so.
  let again = 0;
  const watch = one =>
    one.lost.then(async () => {
      lose();
      const next = ++again <= 3 ? await request() : null;
      if (!next) {
        document.body.textContent = "This page lost its GPU device, and the browser gave it no other.";
        return;
      }
      gpu = next;
      make();
      watch(next);
      found();
    });
  watch(gpu);
}
